recruitment_pathways.title: UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Indian Citizen (for IAS/IPS), Age 21-32 as of 1st August of exam year. Relaxation for OBC (+3 yrs), SC/ST (+5 yrs). Max 6 attempts for General.
selection_stages: Stage 1: Civil Services Preliminary Exam (Objective CSAT & GS)
Stage 2: Civil Services Main Exam (9 Written Descriptive Papers)
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Graduate Degree in any discipline from recognized university

recruitment_pathways.title: UPSC Indian Forest Service (IFoS) Examination
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Science or Engineering graduate. Strict physical measurements (Chest & Height) and 25 km walking endurance test for males (14 km for females).
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Bachelor's degree with at least one subject among Forestry, Botany, Chemistry, Physics, Zoology, Geology, Agriculture, or Engineering

recruitment_pathways.title: Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level (SSC CGL)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Age 18-30 for Assistant Section Officer / Inspector posts. Age relaxation applicable for reserved categories. Computer proficiency mandatory.
selection_stages: Tier 1: Computer Based Objective Test (General Intelligence, Awareness, Quant, English)
Tier 2: Paper 1 (Math, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Computer, Data Entry)
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline

recruitment_pathways.title: UPSC Combined Defense Services (CDS) Examination
recruitment_pathways.cycle_frequency: Bi-annual (CDS I in April, CDS II in September)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Unmarried male and female candidates. Age 19-24. High physical fitness benchmarks.
selection_stages: Written Examination (English, General Knowledge, Elementary Mathematics)
5-Day Services Selection Board (SSB) Interview & Psychological Testing
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Degree for IMA/OTA, Engineering for Air Force / Navy

recruitment_pathways.title: UPSC National Defence Academy (NDA & NA) Examination
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Age 16.5 to 19.5 years. Candidates appearing in Class 12 eligible.
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Class 12th pass (Physics & Math for Air Force / Navy)

recruitment_pathways.title: Air Force Common Admission Test (AFCAT)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Flying Branch (Age 20-24), Ground Duty Technical & Non-Technical (Age 20-26).
selection_stages: Pilot Aptitude Battery Test (PABT / CPSS for Flying)
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Graduation with minimum 60% marks and 50% marks in Math & Physics at 10+2 level

recruitment_pathways.title: Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Direct recruitment into Maharatna PSUs (ONGC, IOCL, NTPC, BHEL, BARC, ISRO) and Master's admissions in IITs/IISc.
selection_stages: Score Validity for 3 Years (M.Tech admissions & PSU recruitment)
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Engineering / Technology / Science or final year student

recruitment_pathways.title: RBI Grade B Officer Recruitment
recruitment_pathways.conducting_body: Reserve Bank of India Services Board
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Age 21-30 years. Maximum 6 attempts for General category in Phase-I.
selection_stages: Phase I Online Examination (Objective General Awareness, Quant, Reasoning, English)
Phase II Written Exam (Economic & Social Issues, English Writing, Finance & Management)
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Minimum 60% marks (50% for SC/ST) in Graduation or post-graduation

recruitment_pathways.title: IBPS Probationary Officer (CWE PO/MT)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Age 20-30. Leads to appointment as Assistant Manager / PO across 11 Nationalized Banks.
selection_stages: Common Interview with Participating Public Sector Banks
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Degree in any discipline from a recognized University

recruitment_pathways.title: UGC National Eligibility Test (UGC-NET / JRF)
recruitment_pathways.eligibility_description: Determines eligibility for Assistant Professorship in Indian Universities and Junior Research Fellowship (JRF) grants.
recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: Master's Degree or equivalent with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC/SC/ST)

recruitment_pathways.title: UPSC Engineering Services Examination (ESE / IES)

recruitment_pathways.min_education_qualification: B.E/B.Tech with minimum 65% marks

recruitment_pathways.title: Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC OCES/DGFS)
